stories.title: DB schema for pay rates
stories.acceptance_criteria: Add standard_rate, enhanced_rate, supervisor_rate (DECIMAL(10,2) NULL) to users. Migration in database/init.py.

stories.title: Auth/core: get and set rates
stories.acceptance_criteria: Add get_user_pay_rates(display_name) and set_user_pay_rates(user_id, standard, enhanced, supervisor). Extend get_all_users() to include rates.

stories.title: Manager UI: set pay rates
stories.acceptance_criteria: In Manage Users tab: per-user expander or inline fields to set Standard/Enhanced/Supervisor £/hr. Save via new API.

stories.title: Export: pay amounts in Excel/PDF
stories.acceptance_criteria: Pass user rates into calculate_staff_summary/export; add columns for pay per rate type and total pay. Excel and PDF both show £ amounts.

stories.title: Personal timesheet: estimated pay
stories.acceptance_criteria: If user has rates set, show estimated pay for the period in personal timesheet.
